definitions.gloss: household account book; household budget book
definitions.explanation: A notebook or record used to track household income and expenses, traditionally kept by the person managing family finances.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{家計簿|かけいぼ}をつける。
examples.english: To keep a household account book every day.

examples.japanese: {家計簿|かけいぼ}をつけ{始|はじ}めてから{無駄遣|むだづか}いが{減|へ}った。
examples.english: Since I started keeping a budget book, my wasteful spending has decreased.

examples.japanese: スマホのアプリで{家計簿|かけいぼ}を{管理|かんり}するのが{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: It's convenient to manage your household budget with a smartphone app.

notes:
A compound of {家計|かけい} (household finances) and {簿|ぼ} (ledger/register). The practice of keeping a {家計簿|かけいぼ} is deeply rooted in Japanese household culture. The concept has also gained international attention under the name "kakeibo" as a budgeting method.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {家計簿|かけいぼ}をつける: to keep a household account book
- {家計簿|かけいぼ}アプリ: budget tracking app
- {家計簿|かけいぼ}を{見直|みなお}す: to review one's household budget

RELATED WORDS:
- {家計|かけい}: household finances/economy
- {帳簿|ちょうぼ}: ledger, account book — general business accounting term
- {出納帳|すいとうちょう}: cash book — more formal record of income and expenditure
